note: Fixed, fabricated relevance set for corpus search. Every provision is invented and states no law. The gate, the corpus, the queries and their relevant rows were written before the fallback was measured, and do not change to suit a result. queries failed the gate with a one-word floor, shown in one_word_floor, which set the two-word floor and the 's' and 't' stop words, so they are not independent of those. held_out was written after that failure and before the two-word floor first ran. A review then narrowed partial hits to a row's heading and text and required a query word with a digit, so both lists have now been measured against changed code and held_out is no longer unseen; no question or label changed. The one-word floor measured 0.25 all-hit precision when Act names counted. Every row now carries a real principal Act's name, because a title's name holds words plain questions use; the provisions stay invented.
rows: An employee who performs duties at a place of residence may deduct the additional running expenses of the room set aside for those duties.
Rent, mortgage interest and rates for a home are occupancy expenses and are private unless the home is a place of business.
A business run from a home keeps a record of the floor area used for the business.
An entity may deduct the cost of using a car for work travel if a logbook is kept for the year.
A logbook records each journey, its purpose and the kilometres travelled.
Travel between home and work is private travel and is not deductible.
Fuel and oil for a motor vehicle are running expenses of the vehicle.
An employee who travels away from home overnight for work may deduct accommodation and meal costs.
A meal or drink provided as entertainment for a client is not deductible.
A gift of money to a deductible gift recipient is deductible if a receipt is held.
The cost of buying and washing a compulsory uniform is deductible; ordinary clothing is private.
Course fees are deductible if the course maintains a skill used in current employment.
An employee may deduct the cost of tools and equipment used for work over their effective life.
The decline in value of a depreciating asset is worked out over its effective life.
A small entity may write off an asset in the year it is first used.
A capital gain on the sale of a dwelling that was the main residence is disregarded.
A capital gain on selling a rental property is included in assessable income.
Rent received from a tenant is assessable income of the owner.
The cost of repairs to a rental property is deductible, but an initial repair or improvement is capital.
A dividend paid by a company to a shareholder is assessable income, and a franking credit may attach.
A loan from a private company to a shareholder is treated as a dividend unless it is put on complying terms.
A beneficiary is assessed on their share of the net income of a trust.
A partner is assessed on their share of the net income of the partnership.
An entity must register for GST when its turnover reaches the registration turnover.
A tax invoice must be held before an input tax credit is claimed.
An entity claims input tax credits for purchases made in carrying on its enterprise.
An activity statement must be lodged by its due date each quarter.
A failure to lodge on time penalty applies to a return lodged after its due date.
General interest charge accrues daily on an unpaid tax debt.
The Commissioner may allow a tax debt to be paid by instalments.
An entity must keep records of its income and expenses for the retention period.
An employer must pay super contributions for each eligible employee by the due date.
A worker engaged under a contract for services is a contractor, not an employee.
An employer withholds an amount from salary or wages paid to an employee.
A car provided to an employee for private use is a car fringe benefit of the employer.
A debt written off as bad may be deducted in the year it is written off.
A tax loss may be carried forward and deducted in a later income year.
A resident is assessed on foreign income and may claim an offset for foreign tax paid.
A person without private hospital cover may pay a levy surcharge.
A digital asset held as an investment is a capital gains tax asset.
